description: This file defines classes `InstanceLockFile` and `InstanceLockFileManager` for managing instance locks, including lock acquisition, release, and status checking, within the Android Cuttlefish project. It declares methods for lock management, including handling multiple lock instances, and uses a `LockFile` implementation from external code.

classes.name: InstanceLockFile
classes.description: Represents a lock for a specific instance, encapsulating a lock file and instance number, with methods for querying status and comparison.

classes.name: InstanceLockFileManager
classes.description: Manages lock files for multiple instances, enabling lock acquisition and release, including bulk operations, and finds available instances.

methods.name: InstanceLockFile::InstanceLockFile
methods.description: Constructor initializing the lock file and instance number.

methods.name: InstanceLockFile::Instance
methods.description: Returns the instance number associated with this lock file.

methods.name: InstanceLockFile::Status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the lock as a Result.

methods.name: InstanceLockFile::Status
methods.description: Sets or updates the status of the lock with a given InUseState.

methods.name: InstanceLockFile::operator<
methods.description: Comparison operator to enable ordering of lock files.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::InstanceLockFileManager
methods.description: Constructor for the lock file manager.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::AcquireLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock for a specific instance number.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::AcquireLocks
methods.description: Attempts to acquire locks for a set of instance numbers.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::TryAcquireLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock for an instance number without blocking.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::TryAcquireLocks
methods.description: Attempts to acquire multiple locks without blocking.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::TryAcquireUnusedLock
methods.description: Attempts to find and lock an available instance id.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::RemoveLockFile
methods.description: Removes the lock file for a specific instance, with a note that this should be replaced with an allocation routine.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::FindPotentialInstanceNumsFromNetDevices
methods.description: Generates a set of potential instance numbers based on network device states.

methods.name: InstanceLockFileManager::LockFilePath
methods.description: Generates the file path for a lock file corresponding to an instance number.
